name: Chaos Energy
description:
The dimensional energy of Mobius. Chaos energy is pure energy and very malleable in what it can do and is known to pull off otherwise impossible miracles. This energy is highly sensitive to the thoughts and emotions of the people who use it. This reactiveness causes two types of Chaos Energy application: Positive from positive emotions, and Negative from negative emotions. This split rooted in emotions causes Chaos Energy to function differently; Positive being superior to Negative. 


Those who are highly attuned to and skilled in Chaos Energy such as Sonic and Shadow can use Chaos Powers including Chaos Spear, Chaos Blast, and famously, Chaos Control. Chaos Control is the most notable due to being able to bend space and time. Extreme amounts of Chaos Energy from either all seven Chaos Emeralds or the Master Emerald grant god-like transformations called Super Forms. These forms can only be accessed for a short period of time, but can perform earth shattering acts during this time. After that time is up, the transformation leaves a slight boost in abilities. Recent theories believe that Chaos Energy in the planet is the cause for unusual natural structures.
